core_obligations: Existence of the four functors (proof lines 9867-9872): the functor u is continuous and cocontinuous, so the existence of g_!, g_!^Ab and of the derived Lg_!, Lg_!^Ab is provided by the modules-on-sites sections on lower shriek and its derived version.

Reduce the two commutativity assertions to one computation (proof lines 9874-9895): by the remarks characterising the shriek on extension-by-zero sheaves it suffices to show that g_!^Ab j_{U'!}O_{U'} = j_{u(U')!}O_{u(U')} is an isomorphism, and for the derived version that Lg_!^Ab j_{U'!}O_{U'} = j_{u(U')!}O_{u(U')} is an isomorphism in D(C); the second implies the first, so only the second is proved.

Localise and use exactness (proof lines 9896-9905): for a localisation morphism j the functors j_! and j_!^Ab agree and j_! is exact, and since Lg_!^Ab composed with j_{U'!} equals j_{U!} composed with L(g')^Ab_! by the localisation lemma and uniqueness of adjoints, it suffices to prove L(g')^Ab_! O_{U'} = O_U.

Conclude by a Yoneda computation (proof lines 9906-9928): the displayed chain of equalities rewrites Hom(L(g')_!^Ab O_{U'}, E) successively through the adjunction, the identification with the pullback of O_V, the adjunction for the localisation morphisms pi'_{U'} and pi_U, and the defining relations of the situation, arriving at Hom(O_U, E); Yoneda's lemma then gives the asserted isomorphism, completing all four parts.
proof_roadmap: Get the four shriek functors from continuity and cocontinuity of u and the modules-on-sites constructions.
Use the characterisation of the lower shriek on extension-by-zero sheaves to reduce both commutativity assertions to the single check Lg_!^Ab j_{U'!}O_{U'} = j_{u(U')!}O_{u(U')}.
Localise to the fibres, use exactness of j_! and uniqueness of adjoints to reduce to L(g')^Ab_! O_{U'} = O_U, and prove it by the displayed Yoneda chain.
difficulty_reason: The lemma assembles the lower shriek functors for a morphism of fibred categories: existence of g_! and g_!^Ab and of their derived versions, and the commutativity of the two diagrams relating them to the abelian-sheaf versions (statement lines 9828-9864). The proof (proof lines 9866-9928) obtains existence from continuity and cocontinuity of u, reduces both commutativity assertions to one isomorphism on extension-by-zero sheaves, localises using exactness of j_! and uniqueness of adjoints, and closes with a Yoneda computation whose chain of adjunctions identifies Hom(L(g')^Ab_!O_{U'}, E) with Hom(O_U, E). H2: a reduction to one local isomorphism followed by one adjunction computation, written out in full.
